question.text: Research analyst engaged in market making activity for the subject company must:

answer.text: Keep this information confidential and not disclose it
Disclose this engagement in the research report
Only disclose upon specific client request

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 19(v): Must disclose whether the analyst/entity has been engaged in market making for the subject company. The Trap: Market making creates a direct conflict of interest. Mandatory disclosure in each relevant report is required. Cross-Exam Context: Ch 14 NISM XV.
